summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, client_secret, client_id, http_path; secret fields client_id and client_secret; profile sets auth_type to oauth and env-var references for both secrets, with profile args applied before the fixed values). Registered it directly after the token mapping in profile_mappings and added it to the exports in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, and profile-arg override protection. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. No commit was made.
